notes.title: On The Brink | Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! 
First of all, thank you for playing! It means the world to us that even just one person has taken a chance on our game. Second, we've heard you! The lack of tutorials made it very frustrating to know how to move around. We're fixing that in this patch, along with a couple of other bugs!

Content
General

 Reduced speed lost from taking damage

Capricorn

 Enlarged tutorial rings for easier orbiting
 Added right-ward movement explanation
 Added constellation drawing explanation
 Added controls for constellation drawing

Taurus

 Added dash aiming tutorial text
 Added goal explanation text

Aquarius

 Fixed a bug where the final cutscene would not play (Windows Only)


Thanks for bearing with us,
and thanks even more for your feedback! We hope this takes away some of the confusion players have been experiencing. Please keep it coming and enjoy playing On The Brink!
